definitions.gloss: dating activities; actively seeking a romantic partner
definitions.explanation: The practice of actively participating in social events, using dating apps, or otherwise making deliberate efforts to find a romantic partner. A modern coined word modeled on 就活 (job hunting).

examples.japanese: {恋活|こいかつ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}した→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I signed up for a dating app.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}われて→誘う：01947_sasou⟧{恋活|こいかつ}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I was invited by a friend to join a matchmaking party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{恋活|こいかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was too busy with work to do any dating activities, but recently I finally have some time.

notes:
A modern abbreviation of ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (romance activities), coined following the pattern of ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧ (job hunting) and ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧ (marriage-seeking activities). Refers to the deliberate, proactive pursuit of a romantic relationship, especially through organized events or dating services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恋活|こいかつ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: dating app
- {恋活|こいかつ}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: matchmaking/singles party
- {恋活|こいかつ}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: dating website
- {恋活|こいかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to actively pursue dating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧: marriage-seeking activities — specifically aimed at finding a marriage partner, more serious than {恋活|こいかつ}
- ⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧: meeting, encounter — a more general term for meeting potential romantic partners
- ⟦{合|ごう}コン→合コン：10273_goukon⟧: group blind date — a specific social event format where groups of men and women meet
